name: The Vault of Ages
intro: The vault door of Nereus swings open on a stair that was not there a moment ago. At the bottom, lamplight, the scratch of a quill, and the smell of more money than anyone has ever seen.

rooms.name: The Vault of Ages - The Counting House
rooms.description: Long tables heaped with coins run the length of the hall, every stack counted and labelled. North, an iron grille bars the way to the ledger hall.

rooms.name: The Vault of Ages - The Hall of Ledgers
rooms.description: Shelves of ledgers climb into the dark, every page a debt. Pages flutter loose from them as you pass. North, the great vault door is shut.

rooms.name: The Vault of Ages - The Vault Itself
rooms.description: The vault: a cave of gold under a sky of hanging lamps. At its heart, at a desk piled with ledgers, the Auditor is waiting for you.

waves.text: Gilded guards step out from between the stacks of coin!
The guard comes running, and the ledgers spit pages of cold fire!
Every ledger on the shelves bursts open at once!

gates.text: The iron grille clanks up into the ceiling.
Tumblers fall one by one — the vault door swings open.

boss.text: Auditor Mordessa looks up from her ledger. 'Ah. The thief. You are expected — page four hundred and nine.' She dips her quill. 'Let us settle your account.'
